rootCause: The two-state phase transition returned from vertical (1) to horizontal (0), but the sweep and animation treated it as the next quarter-turn in a four-state rotation. The return incorrectly switched to the opposite two diagonal cells and included the statue at (12,7).
fix: Two-state shelves retrace the same seven cells on their return. The configured direction describes H-to-V; V-to-H turns in the opposite direction.
Runtime collision checks, authored-frame mirroring and the map-editor overlay/arrow use the same effective turn direction.
The editor labels the two-state setting H-to-V direction and explains the return movement.
Four-state shelves continue turning in the configured direction. Real swept obstacles still block both two-state poses.

exactRegression.beforeFix: All four pose/plate combinations failed with statue fixed at (12,7). Horizontal starts failed on the second press; vertical starts failed on the first.
exactRegression.afterFix: All four combinations complete three presses, including return rotations, in EditMode and through the actual PuzzlePrototypeController in PlayMode. The statue stays at (12,7).

paintedFrameCoverage: PlayMode measures the actual sprite-alpha diagonal including renderer mirroring for both two-state poses/directions and four-state reverse poses, and checks terminal, pause and undo behavior.
cartRegressionNote: Updated the real ET-12 cart-departure route for the corrected two-state geometry. The earlier route reaches a doll blocked by the newly correct returning shelf. The new route still presses before the cart leaves and commits the rotation after that move.
archivedPolicyTests: CommercialPolishPolicyTests not run: archived. No new feedback event, intensity, time-scale change or input block.
testReportingNote: The broad EditMode runner reports 55 passed but preserves only 37 individual records. The exact (12,7) regression is also rerun separately and preserves all four passing pose/plate records in after_fix_exact_coordinate.json.
